sources.source: ONS Crime Severity Score: year ending March 2025
sources.verified_fact: Released 9 December 2025, the official CSS dataset provides severity scores for police-force and community-safety-partnership areas.
sources.quality_effect: Adds the correct official severity benchmark while forbidding the project security score from being relabelled as ONS CSS.

sources.source: Crime outcomes year to December 2025: data tables
sources.verified_fact: Published 23 April 2026, the official tables report outcomes assigned to recorded offences by outcome and offence type through December 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an official outcome-distribution cross-check; outcomes are not interpreted as incident severity or parcel safety.

sources.source: Hate crime, England and Wales, year ending March 2025
sources.verified_fact: Published 9 October 2025, the release records five centrally monitored hate-crime strands and states that MPS trend data is not directly comparable across its February 2024 system change.
sources.quality_effect: Adds protected-characteristic safety context while preserving the explicit MPS comparability break and excluding individual inference.

sources.verified_fact: The current victim workbook covers January 2003 to December 2025 at borough level; the dataset is quarterly-lagged and excludes homicides recorded under City of London Police or British Transport Police jurisdiction.
sources.quality_effect: Adds high-severity borough context with jurisdiction and update-lag guards; it is not a parcel-level rate.

sources.verified_fact: The current file covers May 2025 to April 2026 and classifies ASB calls under personal, nuisance and environmental qualifiers using 13 headings.
sources.quality_effect: Adds current call-based ASB context; calls and response fields are not treated as confirmed crimes, complete LSOA totals or parcel measurements.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Project security_score_percent must not be labelled as ONS Crime Severity Score.
Outcome distributions are not crime severity values.
MPS hate-crime trends cross a February 2024 recording-system comparability break.
MPS homicide data is borough-level, quarterly-lagged and excludes COLP/BTP jurisdiction records.
ASB calls are operational reports, not confirmed crimes or complete area totals.
No existing candidate score or stored parcel value was modified.
